elements.name: web-treeview
elements.description:
---


### **Events:**
 - **node-click** - A node was clicked (a checkbox toggle is not a click — see `checked-change`). `detail`: the node with `path`, `parent`, `siblings`. Twin: `onNodeClick(detail)`.
- **node-double-click** - A node was double-clicked. `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeDoubleClick(detail)`.
- **node-expand** - A node expanded (toggle, keyboard, `expandNodes`, after any `beforeExpandCallback` load; NOT `expandAll` / expand-level seeding — those only fire `expanded-change`). `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeExpand(detail)`.
- **node-collapse** - A node collapsed (toggle, keyboard, `collapseNodes`, an accordion sibling; NOT `collapseAll`). `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeCollapse(detail)`.
- **node-copy** - Nodes were copied. `detail`: `{ operation, paths, nodes }`. Twin: `onNodeCopy(detail)`.
- **node-cut** - Nodes were cut. `detail`: `{ operation, paths, nodes }`. Twin: `onNodeCut(detail)`.
- **node-paste** - A paste ran (not fired when `beforePasteCallback` blocked it). `detail`: the PasteResult (`success`, `count`, `skipped`, `error?`, `entries?`, …). Twin: `onNodePaste(detail)`.
- **node-delete** - Nodes were deleted. `detail`: `{ paths, nodes }` (pre-removal snapshots). Twin: `onNodeDelete(detail)`.
- **node-drag-start** - A node drag started. `detail`: the drag context (`event`, `dragged`). Twin: `onNodeDragStart(detail)`.
- **node-drag-over** - A node was dragged over. `detail`: the drag context. Twin: `onNodeDragOver(detail)`.
- **node-drop** - A drop completed. `detail`: `{ source, target, dragged, dropped, position, operation, event }`. Twin: `onNodeDrop(detail)`.
- **node-drag-reject** - A locked node was long-pressed / an undraggable drag was attempted. `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeDragReject(detail)`.
- **node-drop-reject** - A drop was rejected by the target. `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeDropReject(detail)`.
- **selection-change** - The selected set changed. `detail`: `{ paths, nodes }`. Twin: `onSelectionChange(detail)`.
- **checked-change** - The checked (checkbox) set changed. `detail`: `{ paths, nodes }`. Twin: `onCheckedChange(detail)`.
- **focus-change** - The focused node changed. `detail`: `{ focusedNode }`. Twin: `onFocusChange(detail)`.
- **expanded-change** - The expanded set changed (toggle, keyboard, expandNodes / collapseNodes, expandAll / collapseAll, accordion, data changes) — one event per change: synchronously right after an expand / collapse (after its `node-expand` / `node-collapse`), on the next microtask after a data change. `detail`: `{ paths }` = the whole new set (same as `expandedPaths`). Not fired for `{ isSilent: true }` operations nor for assigning `expandedPaths`. Twin: `onExpandedChange(detail)`.
- **nodes-reorder** - A sort (`sortNodes` / `sortAll` / the `sort*` menu items) with a `compareCallback` or `direction: "desc"` rewrote the `orderMember` values (10, 20, 30…) of the children of one parent — one event per parent; never without `orderMember`. `detail`: `{ parentPath, nodes, changes: [{ path, oldOrder, newOrder }] }`. Twin: `onNodesReorder(detail)`.
- **tree-change** - The data / structure changed — add / insert / update / move / remove, `applyChanges`, add / insert / replace / removeBranch, paste, drop, duplicate, sort. One event per change (a compound op such as a multi-node drop fires once), on the microtask after it. Not for expand / select / check / focus nor for loading `nodes`; read the new state from `controller.nodes`. `detail`: the context only. Twin: `onTreeChange(detail)`.
- **action** - A context-menu item was activated. `detail`: `action` (built-in name or `custom`), `id`, `item`, `source: "context-menu"`, `node` / `path` / `parent` / `siblings`, `sourceEvent`, `triggerElement`. Fires after the item’s `onClick`, before the built-in. Twin: `onAction(detail)`.
- **render-start** - A progressive render began (`isRendering` turns true). `detail`: the context only. Twin: `onRenderStart(detail)`.
- **render-progress** - A progressive-render batch finished. `detail`: `{ pending, processed }`. Twin: `onRenderProgress(detail)`.
- **render-complete** - The progressive render finished (`isRendering` turns false). `detail`: `{ pending, processed }`. Twin: `onRenderComplete(detail)`.
- **index-progress** - The async search index filled another batch, and once more with `isComplete: true` at the end — search / filter results are partial until then. `detail`: `{ processed, total, isComplete }`. Twin: `onIndexProgress(detail)`.
- **search-status-change** - A filter was applied or cleared (also the automatic re-filter when indexing completes). `detail`: `{ searchTerm, matchCount, isLimited, limit, isIndexing }` — `isLimited` = more matched than `search-result-limit` and the rest were cut off. Twin: `onSearchStatusChange(detail)`.
- **container-resize** - The tree container was resized (also once when the tree starts observing). `detail`: `{ size: { width, height }, deviceClass }` — `size` is also `el.containerSize`. Twin: `onContainerResize(detail)`.
- **ready** - Fired once after the first live build (core, SPEC §6.3), on the microtask after it; also the `ready` attribute, `:state(ready)`, `isReady` and `whenReady()`. Twin callback `onReady`.
- **input-rejected** - Fired when a written value is refused (core, SPEC §6): an invalid attribute or property value, or an unknown `setAttributes()` key. The element warns and keeps its previous value. Detail `{ configKey, attribute?, value, reason?, kept, source }`. Twin callback `onInputRejected`.

### **Methods:**
 





- **filterNodes(term: _string_, searchOptions: _SearchOptions_): _void_** - Filter the visible tree to `term` (empty = clear); `searchOptions` go to FlexSearch.
- **searchNodes(term: _string | null_, searchOptions: _SearchOptions_): _LTreeNode<T>[]_** - The nodes matching `term` (no filtering); `searchOptions` go to FlexSearch.
- **activateMenuItem(item: _TreeMenuItem<T>_, ctx: _TreeMenuContext<T>_, trigger: _HTMLElement_, event: _Event_): _Promise<boolean>_** - Run a menu item exactly like the built-in menu: `beforeActionCallback` (`false` cancels) →
item `onClick(detail)` → built-in action → `action` event. For `renderContextMenuCallback`:
`ctx.controller.activateMenuItem(entry.item, ctx, button, event)`. Resolves `false` when
cancelled; closing the menu is the caller's job.
- **insertNode(targetPath: _string_, nodeData: _T_, position: _DropPosition_): _any_** - Insert one node before / after `targetPath` (as its sibling) or as its last child.
- **copyNodeWithDescendants(sourceNode: _LTreeNode<T>_, targetParentPath: _string_, transform: _(ctx: { data: T; node: LTreeNode<T> } & TreeViewContext<T>) => T | null_, siblingPath: _string_, position: _'before' | 'after'_): _any_** - Copy one node (+ descendants) under a parent; `transform({ data, node })` may return null to skip.
- **applyChanges(changes: _TreeChange<T>[]_): _ApplyChangesResult_** - Apply a batch of add / update / remove changes.
- **getTree(): _Ltree<T> | undefined_** - Access the underlying LTree for advanced programmatic usage.
- **getNodeRef(path: _string_): _NodeRef<T>_** - The node at `path` with its live parent and siblings.
- **refreshNode(path: _string_): _void_** - Re-render the node at `path` after its data object was changed in place.
- **refreshSiblings(parentPath: _string_): _void_** - Re-sort the children of `parentPath` (`''` = the roots) by the tree's rule and re-render.
- **isNodeDropAllowed(path: _string_): _boolean_** - Whether the node at `path` accepts drops (`getIsDropAllowedCallback` → `isDropAllowedMember`); `false` for an unknown path.
- **openContextMenu(path: _string_, x: _number_, y: _number_): _void_** - Open the context menu for the node at `path` at viewport coordinates.
- **insertBranch(targetPath: _string_, data: _T[]_, position: _DropPosition_): _InsertBranchResult<T>_** - Insert a branch before / after `targetPath` (block order kept) or under it (`'child'`).
- **toggleFocusedSelect(): _void_** - Toggle the focused node in / out of the selection (Ctrl+click semantics). Multiple selection mode only.
- **sortNodes(paths: _string | string[]_, options: _SortOptions<T>_): _void_** - Sort the children of each node (one level; `''` = the roots) by the tree's rule
(`sortCallback` → `orderMember` → display value, numeric-aware) or `options.compareCallback`;
`direction: 'desc'` reverses it. Fires `nodes-reorder` when `orderMember` values were
rewritten (unless `isSilent`). Works with `isSortingEnabled` off too.
- **sortAll(paths: _string | string[] | null_, options: _SortOptions<T>_): _void_** - Sort whole subtrees — the nodes' children at every depth; `null` / omitted = the whole
tree. Same rule / options / event as sortNodes.
- **pasteNodes(targetPath: _string_, transform: _NodeTransformCallback<T> | null_, position: _DropPosition_): _PasteResult<T>_** - Paste under / beside `targetPath`; `transform(ctx{ data, … })` overrides nodeInputTransformationCallback.
- **removeNodes(paths: _string[]_): _{ removed: number; failed: number }_** - Programmatic removal (no `beforeDeleteCallback`, no `node-delete` — those belong to the user Delete command).

- **whenReady(): _Promise<void>_** - Resolves once the first build is live (also settles when the element is destroyed first). Never rejects.
- **release(): _void_** - Build an element held by `defer` (SPEC §6.3), with everything assigned meanwhile.
- **setAttributes(values: _Record<string, unknown>_): _InputRejection[]_** - Apply many inputs (by configKey or attribute name) as ONE rebuild / update. Returns the values it refused (each also fires `input-rejected`).
- **batch(fn: _() => void_): _void_** - Run `fn` and coalesce every input change it makes into one rebuild / update.
- **flush(): _void_** - Apply pending input writes synchronously, now (SPEC §12.7).
- **whenSettled(): _Promise<void>_** - Resolves once every staged input change has been applied (SPEC §12.7).
- **destroy(): _void_** - Final teardown (SPEC §6.5): the element is inert afterwards; idempotent.
- **enableLogging(level: _LogLevelDesc_): _void_** - Set this element's own log level (default `debug`): it logs that level and above, whatever its component type or the page is set to.
- **disableLogging(): _void_** - Silence this element (its own level = `silent`).
- **resetLogging(): _void_** - Clear this element's own log level: it follows its component type / the page again.
- **checkValidity(): _boolean_** - Form validity check (SPEC §6.6).
- **reportValidity(): _boolean_** - Form validity check that reports to the user (SPEC §6.6).

### **CSS Properties:**
 - **--wtv-rem** - Base sizing unit for proportional scaling (default: 10px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-accent-color** - Primary accent color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-accent-color-hover** - Accent color on hover _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-text-color-1** - Primary text color (input: reads --base-text-color-1) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-main-bg** - Tree surface background (input: reads --base-main-bg) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-text-color-3** - Tertiary text — toggle glyph, info button, paths, "loading more" (reads --base-text-color-3) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-text-color-on-accent** - Text on accent backgrounds _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-shadow-color** - Shadow color for every shadow (reads --base-shadow-color) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-success-color** - Success role — valid drop (reads --base-success-color) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-danger-color** - Danger role fill — invalid drop, drag-denied (reads --base-danger-color) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-danger-text-color** - Danger as text — menu danger item (reads --base-danger-text-color) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-hover-bg** - Neutral hover overlay (reads --base-hover-bg) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-active-bg** - Neutral pressed overlay (reads --base-active-bg) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-elevated-bg** - Raised surface — full-label popover (reads --base-elevated-bg) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-selected-bg** - Selected-row background tint (the click / Ctrl / Shift-click set); reads --base-selected-bg (fallback --base-primary-bg-subtle, then accent 10% / 20% dark) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-selected-bg-hover** - Selected-row background on hover; reads --base-selected-bg-hover (fallback --wtv-selected-bg) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-focused-bg** - Background of the focused (cursor) row when not selected; reads --base-focused-bg (fallback transparent) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-selected-fill-bg** - Background for the opt-in .wtv__node-content--selected-fill flavor (Explorer-style strong fill); unused by the default selected state _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-info-reveal-bg** - Full-label popover background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-info-reveal-text-color** - Full-label popover text color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-info-reveal-border-color** - Full-label popover border color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-info-reveal-box-shadow** - Full-label popover shadow (← --base-shadow-lg) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-border-color** - Divider / spinner track color (reads --base-border-color) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-input-border-color** - Control outline — checkbox border (reads --base-input-border-color) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-border-width** - Hairline width — menu, checkbox, popover (reads --base-border-width) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-selected-preset-ring-color** - Hairline ring color of the opt-in --selected-border / --selected-glow presets (accent 45%) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-border-radius-sm** - Small radius (reads --base-border-radius-sm × rem) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-border-radius-lg** - Large radius (reads --base-border-radius-lg × rem) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-disabled-opacity** - Disabled dimming — checkbox, menu item (reads --base-disabled-opacity, 0.65) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-disabled-tree-opacity** - The whole tree while `disabled` (reads --wtv-disabled-opacity) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-selected-text-color** - Selected row text color (reads --base-selected-text-color) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-selected-outline** - Selected row outline shorthand, drawn inset (reads --base-selected-outline) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-focused-text-color** - Focused row text color (reads --base-focused-text-color) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-focused-outline** - Focus ring outline shorthand, drawn inset (reads --base-focused-outline) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-selected-fill-text-color** - Text color of the opt-in --selected-fill flavor _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-font-family** - Component font family (overrides --base-font-family) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-font-size-xs** - Extra-small font size (reads --base-font-size-xs × rem) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-font-size-sm** - Small font size (reads --base-font-size-sm × rem) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-font-size** - Row font size (default --*-font-size-sm) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-font-weight-medium** - Medium weight (reads --base-font-weight-medium) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-font-weight-semibold** - Semibold weight (reads --base-font-weight-semibold) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-spacing-xs** - Spacing step xs (0.2 × rem) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-spacing-sm** - Spacing step sm (0.4 × rem) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-spacing-md** - Spacing step md (0.8 × rem) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-spacing-lg** - Spacing step lg (1.2 × rem) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-spacing-xl** - Spacing step xl (1.6 × rem) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-transition-fast** - Fast transition (reads --base-duration-fast, 0.1s; 0s under reduced motion) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-transition-normal** - Normal transition — toggle, hover, tooltip, drop zones (reads --base-duration-normal, 0.15s; 0s under reduced motion) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-transition-medium** - Medium transition (reads --base-duration-medium, 0.25s; 0s under reduced motion) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-transition-slow** - Slow transition — drag-denied tint (reads --base-duration-slow, 0.3s; 0s under reduced motion) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-ease-standard** - Standard easing (reads --base-ease-standard) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-ease-out** - Ease-out (reads --base-ease-out) — entering feedback _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-ease-in** - Ease-in (reads --base-ease-in) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-transition** - Row transition (default none = instant hover) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-toggle-icon-transition** - Expand / collapse turn of the glyph _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-bg-hover** - Row hover background (default --*-hover-bg) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-bg-active** - Row pressed background (default --*-active-bg) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-focused-outline-offset** - Outline offset for the focus ring / selected ring (default calc(-1 * var(--base-outline-width, 1px)) = inset) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-toggle-icon-width** - Width of the toggle column _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-indent-size** - Per-level indent step (reads --base-tree-indent, 1.6 × --wtv-rem = 16px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-scroll-behavior** - scrollToPath / paste-reveal scrolling behaviour when the caller passes none; keyboard moves always scroll instantly (reads --base-scroll-behavior, smooth; auto under reduced motion) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-padding** - Row pill padding _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-border-radius** - Corner radius of the row pill _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-height** - Node row height (32px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-icon-color** - Per-node icon color (default currentColor; overridden by a per-node iconColor / iconColorMember) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-icon-margin-right** - Gap between the per-node icon and the label _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-icon-width** - Reserved icon-column width when shouldAlignNodeIcons is on _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-toggle-icon-size** - Disclosure glyph size (font-size of the toggle column) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-toggle-icon-color** - Disclosure glyph color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-info-color** - Info button color (nodeTitleOverflow info) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-info-color-hover** - Info button hover color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-node-info-bg-hover** - Info button hover background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-expand** - Disclosure glyph mask (collapsed / the only glyph in rotate mode); chained to --base-icon-chevron. Re-pointed per icon-set. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-collapse** - Disclosure glyph mask shown when expanded (swap mode only); chained to --base-icon-collapse for the plus-minus set. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-leaf** - Optional leaf marker glyph mask (opt-in via leafIconClass=wtv__toggle-icon--leaf). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-rotate-collapsed** - Collapsed-state rotation for the disclosure glyph (0deg for a right-pointing chevron, -90deg for a down-caret). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-rotate-expanded** - Expanded-state rotation for the disclosure glyph (90deg for chevron). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-size-glyph** - Disclosure glyph mask box size (default 1em). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-scroll-highlight-box-shadow** - scrollToPath highlight glow _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-info** - Info button glyph (mask) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-check** - Checkmark glyph (mask) for a checked checkbox; chains to --base-icon-check. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-indeterminate** - Dash glyph (mask) for a tri-state/partial checkbox; chains to --base-icon-indeterminate. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-icon-check-size** - mask-size of the check/dash glyph inside the box; chains to --base-icon-check-size (default 68%). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-size** - Checkbox box dimension (default 1.6×rem). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-gap** - Space between the checkbox and the node pill _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-scale** - Box/border/radius scale via calc (shared --base-checkbox-scale contract, no transform). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-border-width** - Checkbox box border thickness (→ --wtv-border-width; multiplied by --wtv-checkbox-scale). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-border-color** - Unchecked checkbox box border color; chains to --base-checkbox-border-color. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-border-radius** - Checkbox box corner radius (flat 0.3×rem, scaled by --wtv-checkbox-scale). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-bg** - Unchecked checkbox box background. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-checked-bg** - Checked / indeterminate checkbox box background (defaults to the accent color). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-checked-border-color** - Checked / indeterminate checkbox box border color. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-checked-bg-hover** - Checked / indeterminate checkbox background on hover (accent hover step). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-checkmark-color** - Check / dash glyph color (tints the mask). _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-focus-ring-width** - Focus-ring thickness for a keyboard-focused checkbox. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-focus-ring-color** - Focus-ring color for a keyboard-focused checkbox. _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-checkbox-focus-box-shadow** - Checkbox focus ring (box-shadow) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-drop-glow-before-color** - Glow + arrow color, drop before _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-drop-glow-after-color** - Glow + arrow color, drop after _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-drop-glow-child-color** - Glow + arrow color, drop as child _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-drop-glow-child-bg** - Row tint, drop as child _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-drop-glow-size** - Glow line thickness _(default: undefined)_

- **--wtv-drop-arrow-after-rotation** - Drop arrow rotation, after _(default: undefined)_

- **--wtv-drop-arrow-before-image** - Drop arrow glyph (mask), before _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-drop-arrow-after-image** - Drop arrow glyph (mask), after _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-drop-arrow-child-image** - Drop arrow glyph (mask), child _(default: undefined)_

- **--wtv-drop-zone-after-bg** - Drop-after zone background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wtv-drop-zone-child-bg** - Drop-as-child zone background _(default: undefined)_

- **--wtv-drop-zone-after-bg-active** - Drop-after zone active background _(default: undefined)_

- **--wtv-drop-placeholder-box-shadow-hover** - Engaged placeholder glow _(default: undefined)_

attributes.name: tree-id
attributes.description: Stable identifier for this tree (clipboard / cross-tree operations).

attributes.name: id-member
attributes.description: Property name on a node object that holds its id.

attributes.name: path-member
attributes.description: Property name that holds a node materialized tree path.

attributes.name: display-value-member
attributes.description: Property name that holds a node display label.

attributes.name: parent-path-member
attributes.description: Property name holding a node parent path.

attributes.name: level-member
attributes.description: Property name holding a node depth level.

attributes.name: is-expanded-member
attributes.description: Property name flagging whether a node is expanded.

attributes.name: is-checked-member
attributes.description: Property name flagging whether a node is checked (checkbox).

attributes.name: is-draggable-member
attributes.description: Property name flagging whether a node is draggable.

attributes.name: is-drop-allowed-member
attributes.description: Property name flagging whether a drop is allowed onto a node.

attributes.name: has-children-member
attributes.description: Property name flagging that a node has children (lazy trees).

attributes.name: search-value-member
attributes.description: Property name a node is searched against.

attributes.name: is-selectable-member
attributes.description: Property name flagging whether a node can be selected.

attributes.name: is-collapsible-member
attributes.description: Property name flagging whether a node can be collapsed.

attributes.name: order-member
attributes.description: Property name used to order sibling nodes.

attributes.name: allowed-drop-positions-member
attributes.description: Property name listing the drop positions allowed on a node.

attributes.name: icon-member
attributes.description: Property name that holds a per-node icon value (rendered on every node as <i class="wtv__node-icon {value}">).

attributes.name: icon-color-member
attributes.description: Property name that holds a per-node icon color (applied to the .wtv__node-icon element).

attributes.name: expand-level
attributes.description: Depth to auto-expand on load (0 = roots only, the default).

attributes.name: tree-path-separator
attributes.description: Separator between segments in a materialized tree path.

attributes.name: click-behavior
attributes.description: What a node click does: select, expand, or expand-and-focus (default).

attributes.name: expand-as-accordion
attributes.description: Accordion mode: expanding a node collapses its siblings.

attributes.name: enable-sorting
attributes.description: Automatic sorting of siblings (default on). Off: the input order is kept, `addNode` appends, `insertNode` / `insertBranch` / `moveNode` / drop keep the exact position (with `orderMember` the order values are still computed). `sortNodes` / `sortAll` still sort; switching it back on re-sorts the tree.

attributes.name: sorted
attributes.description: Hint: data is already in insert order (parents first, siblings ordered) — skips sorting the input; faster on big data.

attributes.name: use-internal-search-index
attributes.description: Build the internal FlexSearch index that filterNodes / searchNodes / search-term query (default on; `false` = no index, search finds nothing).

attributes.name: indexer-batch-size
attributes.description: Max nodes indexed per idle slot when building the search index (default 1000). Each slot is also time-boxed (≤16 ms, ≤8 ms when forced on a busy page), which is what keeps the UI smooth.

attributes.name: indexer-timeout
attributes.description: Idle timeout (ms) between search-index batches.

attributes.name: search-term
attributes.description: Active search/filter term.

attributes.name: search-result-limit
attributes.description: Max matches a search / filter returns (default 1000; FlexSearch's own silent default was 100). Check `search-status-change` `detail.isLimited` to tell users the result was truncated.

attributes.name: filter-scope
attributes.description: EXPERIMENTAL — which descendants of a filter match stay visible (ancestors always do): `matches` (default), `descendants` (whole subtree), `tree-depth` (whole subtree for a match at level ≥ max depth − x), `subtree-height` (whole subtree if it is ≤ x levels deep), `levels-below` (x levels under each match). x = filter-descendant-depth.

attributes.name: filter-descendant-depth
attributes.description: EXPERIMENTAL — the x for the depth-limited filter scopes. Default 1.

attributes.name: expand-filter-descendants
attributes.description: EXPERIMENTAL — expand the descendants a filter scope adds (default on). Off: they start collapsed (matches + ancestors stay expanded) — keeps a top-level match on a big tree cheap.

attributes.name: body-class
attributes.description: Extra class on the tree body container.

attributes.name: selected-node-class
attributes.description: Class applied to selected nodes.

attributes.name: focused-node-class
attributes.description: Class applied to the focused node.

attributes.name: checked-node-class
attributes.description: Class applied to checked nodes — opt-in extra styling; the checkbox is the default signal.

attributes.name: drag-over-node-class
attributes.description: Class applied to a node being dragged over.

attributes.name: dragged-node-class
attributes.description: Class for the dragged source row; replaces the built-in .wtv__node-content--dragged visual.

attributes.name: show-node-tooltips
attributes.description: Enable hover/focus tooltips on node rows (content from getNodeTooltipCallback).

attributes.name: tooltip-placement
attributes.description: Tooltip placement relative to the row. Default top-start.

attributes.name: tooltip-delay
attributes.description: Show/hide delay (ms). The attribute sets both; the JS property also accepts { show, hide }. Default { show: 400, hide: 100 }.

attributes.name: tooltip-offset
attributes.description: Gap from the row (or cursor), px. Default 8.

attributes.name: tooltip-follow-cursor
attributes.description: Anchor the tooltip to the pointer instead of the row.

attributes.name: icon-set
attributes.description: Disclosure glyph set: chevron (default) | triangle | plus-minus | arrow. Re-points the --wtv-icon-* variables via a :host([icon-set]) rule; reflected to the attribute so the CSS matches when set via the JS property.

attributes.name: leaf-icon-class
attributes.description: Icon class for leaf nodes.

attributes.name: toggle-icon-mode
attributes.description: Whether the toggle glyph rotates (single glyph, default) or swaps (expand↔collapse glyph). Reflected to the attribute so the :host([toggle-icon-mode="swap"]) CSS matches via the JS property.

attributes.name: scroll-highlight-class
attributes.description: Class flashed on a node after scrollToPath().

attributes.name: scroll-highlight-timeout
attributes.description: How long (ms) the scroll highlight stays before clearing.

attributes.name: node-title-overflow
attributes.description: A too-long built-in label: `wrap` (multi-line; rows grow — avoid with virtual scroll), `ellipsis` (single-line clip, default) or `info` (ellipsis + a trailing info button on clipped rows that reveals the full label). renderNodeCallback content owns its layout.

attributes.name: align-node-icons
attributes.description: Reserve a fixed icon column so node labels align.

attributes.name: context-menu-x-offset
attributes.description: Horizontal offset (px) of the context menu from the pointer.

attributes.name: context-menu-y-offset
attributes.description: Vertical offset (px) of the context menu from the pointer.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disable the tree like a native form control: no user interaction (check, select, expand / collapse, drag, drop, copy / cut / paste / delete, context menu, keyboard), out of the tab order, `aria-disabled="true"`, dimmed (`--wtv-disabled-tree-opacity`). Programmatic API calls still work. Re-enabling restores everything.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Read-only tree like a native read-only control: the user cannot change the data — no check, drag, drop, cut / paste / delete (shortcuts and built-in menu items), no sort from the menu — but the tree stays focusable and navigable: keyboard navigation, scroll, expand / collapse, selection highlight and copy work. Not dimmed. Programmatic API calls still work.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Show the loading state.

attributes.name: drag-drop-mode
attributes.description: Drag-drop mode: `none` (off, default), `self` (within this tree), `cross` (between trees), or `both`.

attributes.name: drop-zone-mode
attributes.description: Drop-zone visual style: floating indicator or glow (default).

attributes.name: drop-zone-layout
attributes.description: Where drop zones render relative to a node (default `around`).

attributes.name: drop-zone-start
attributes.description: Where drop zones begin. A number is a percentage of node width; a string is used as-is (`px` or `%`, e.g. "50px").

attributes.name: drop-zone-max-width
attributes.description: Maximum floating drop-zone width, a CSS length (`120px`, `8rem`, `30%`); a number means pixels on both paths (`drop-zone-max-width="90"` / `el.dropZoneMaxWidth = 90` → `90px`). Default `120px`.

attributes.name: allow-copy
attributes.description: Allow the copy clipboard operation.

attributes.name: auto-handle-copy
attributes.description: Let the tree perform the copy itself (vs delegating to onCopy).

attributes.name: auto-handle-move
attributes.description: Let the tree perform a move drop itself (default). `false`: the tree is not mutated — `node-drop` fires and the consumer moves the nodes.

attributes.name: auto-handle-paste
attributes.description: Let the tree perform the paste itself (vs delegating to onPaste).

attributes.name: handle-keyboard-shortcuts
attributes.description: Handle copy/cut/paste/delete keyboard shortcuts.

attributes.name: touch-drag-delay
attributes.description: Long-press hold (ms) before a touch-drag engages (default 300).

attributes.name: indicate-undraggable
attributes.description: Built-in "can't move/drop this" feedback (🚫 badge + haptic). Default true.

attributes.name: enable-tree-drop-zone
attributes.description: Make the whole populated tree one drop target (drop lands target=null regardless of per-node drop rules).

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: UI strings — a partial object (JSON attribute) merged per key over the English defaults (an empty string = render nothing): `noData` ("No data" — no nodes), `noResults` ("No results found" — the search filter left nothing), `noDisplayValue` ("[N/A]" — node without a display value), `loading` ("Loading…" — spinner aria-label), `dropHere` ("Drop here"), `showFullLabel` ("Show full label" — the node-title-overflow="info" button), `copy`, `cut`, `paste`, `delete`, `expand`, `collapse`, `expandSubtree`, `collapseSubtree`, `expandAll`, `collapseAll`, `sort`, `sortSubtree`, `sortAll` (built-in context-menu items), `back` ("Back") / `close` ("Close") (the context menu as a phone sheet / drawer: submenu back row, header close button). `{name}` placeholders.

attributes.name: show-empty-drop-placeholder
attributes.description: Show a drop placeholder when the tree is empty.

attributes.name: highlight-on-page-drag
attributes.description: Arm the drop target while a tree NODE is dragged anywhere over the page (any tree): the host gets the `armed` attribute + `:state(armed)`, and an empty tree shows its drop zone at once with `--wtv-drop-placeholder-bg-armed` (the zone under the pointer keeps the engaged look). Cleared on drop anywhere, when the drag leaves the window, on Escape / `dragend`, and on disconnect. Never armed while `drag-drop-mode="none"`, disabled or read-only. One shared page listener for all instances (same option as web-dropzone).

attributes.name: enable-flat-rendering
attributes.description: Render the visible nodes as a flat list (perf).

attributes.name: flat-indent-size
attributes.description: Indent per level in flat rendering, a CSS length (`20px`, `1.5rem`); a bare number means pixels (`flat-indent-size="20"` → `20px`). Default `var(--wtv-indent-size)`.

attributes.name: enable-progressive-render
attributes.description: Render large trees in progressive batches.

attributes.name: initial-batch-size
attributes.description: Rows rendered in the first progressive batch.

attributes.name: max-batch-size
attributes.description: Maximum rows per progressive batch.

attributes.name: enable-virtual-scroll
attributes.description: Enable virtual scrolling.

attributes.name: virtual-scroll-item-height
attributes.description: Fixed row height (px) used by virtual scrolling.

attributes.name: virtual-scroll-overscan
attributes.description: Extra rows rendered above/below the viewport when virtualizing.

attributes.name: virtual-scroll-container-height
attributes.description: Height of the virtual-scroll viewport, a CSS length (`400px`, `30rem`, `50vh`); a bare number means pixels. Unset: the measured tree height (else 400px).

attributes.name: range-selection-mode
attributes.description: How Shift+click range selection walks the tree (default `visual`).

attributes.name: selection-mode
attributes.description: Single- (default) or multi-node selection.

attributes.name: show-checkboxes
attributes.description: Show a checkbox on each node.

attributes.name: checkbox-mode
attributes.description: Checkbox interaction: `independent` (default) toggles one node; `cascade` toggles the subtree with a tristate box on branches.

attributes.name: cascade-check-policy
attributes.description: Which paths the checked set EMITS in cascade mode: `rolled-up` (minimal cover), `leaves`, or `all`. Default rolled-up.

attributes.name: click-toggle-checkbox
attributes.description: A node-row click also toggles its checkbox.

attributes.name: custom-styles
attributes.description: CSS injected into the shadow root (a full stylesheet; `@import url(…)` works) — the declarative alternative to `getCustomStylesCallback`, which wins when both are set. Comes after the page-wide `window.components["web-treeview"].customStyles`, so it overrides it.

attributes.name: menu-presentation
attributes.description: How the component's context / dropdown menus open: 'auto' (default — a bottom sheet on a phone, the floating menu elsewhere), 'floating', 'sheet' (bottom sheet) or 'drawer' (full-height side panel on `menu-side`). Per device / width through the responsive rules.

attributes.name: menu-side
attributes.description: The edge a 'drawer' menu slides in from: 'start' (default — left in LTR, right in RTL) or 'end'.

attributes.name: defer
attributes.description: Hold the first build (core, SPEC §6.3): while set when the element first connects, nothing is built and every input, callback and listener assigned meanwhile accumulates; `release()` (or removing the attribute) then builds once. Latched after the first build.

attributes.name: theme-source
attributes.description: Where this element reads its theme from instead of the page (core, SPEC §12.10): a CSS selector (nearest matching ancestor, else the first match), `'closest'` (the nearest ancestor carrying a theme signal), or (property only) an `Element`. Unset = the page.

attributes.name: motion
attributes.description: Motion level (core, SPEC §12.16): `auto` (default — inherit: the nearest `data-motion` ancestor (a section), else the page level `window.components.motion` / `<html data-motion>`; closest wins), `none` (no transitions, instant scrolling), `snappy` (short) or `smooth` (longer). Sets the shared `--base-duration-*` / `--base-scroll-behavior` tokens on the element through `data-motion`; the OS reduced-motion setting always wins.

attributes.name: responsive
attributes.description: Instance responsive rules (core, SPEC §6.7): partial configs on two axes — `device` (keyed by device class `mobile` / `tablet` / `desktop`; a mouse device is `desktop` at any width) and `breakpoint` (keyed by the window-width bucket); the breakpoint entry applies first, the device entry over it (device wins). An object or a JSON attribute, e.g. `{"device":{"tablet":{"presentation":"modal"}},"breakpoint":{"mobile":{…}}}`. Beats page rules (`window.components.responsive*`) and values set on the element; never reflects. An entry of `null` ignores the page rules while it matches.

events.name: node-click
events.description: A node was clicked (a checkbox toggle is not a click — see `checked-change`). `detail`: the node with `path`, `parent`, `siblings`. Twin: `onNodeClick(detail)`.

events.name: node-double-click
events.description: A node was double-clicked. `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeDoubleClick(detail)`.

events.name: node-expand
events.description: A node expanded (toggle, keyboard, `expandNodes`, after any `beforeExpandCallback` load; NOT `expandAll` / expand-level seeding — those only fire `expanded-change`). `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeExpand(detail)`.

events.name: node-collapse
events.description: A node collapsed (toggle, keyboard, `collapseNodes`, an accordion sibling; NOT `collapseAll`). `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeCollapse(detail)`.

events.name: node-copy
events.description: Nodes were copied. `detail`: `{ operation, paths, nodes }`. Twin: `onNodeCopy(detail)`.

events.name: node-cut
events.description: Nodes were cut. `detail`: `{ operation, paths, nodes }`. Twin: `onNodeCut(detail)`.

events.name: node-paste
events.description: A paste ran (not fired when `beforePasteCallback` blocked it). `detail`: the PasteResult (`success`, `count`, `skipped`, `error?`, `entries?`, …). Twin: `onNodePaste(detail)`.

events.name: node-delete
events.description: Nodes were deleted. `detail`: `{ paths, nodes }` (pre-removal snapshots). Twin: `onNodeDelete(detail)`.

events.name: node-drag-start
events.description: A node drag started. `detail`: the drag context (`event`, `dragged`). Twin: `onNodeDragStart(detail)`.

events.name: node-drag-over
events.description: A node was dragged over. `detail`: the drag context. Twin: `onNodeDragOver(detail)`.

events.name: node-drop
events.description: A drop completed. `detail`: `{ source, target, dragged, dropped, position, operation, event }`. Twin: `onNodeDrop(detail)`.

events.name: node-drag-reject
events.description: A locked node was long-pressed / an undraggable drag was attempted. `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeDragReject(detail)`.

events.name: node-drop-reject
events.description: A drop was rejected by the target. `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeDropReject(detail)`.

events.name: selection-change
events.description: The selected set changed. `detail`: `{ paths, nodes }`. Twin: `onSelectionChange(detail)`.

events.name: checked-change
events.description: The checked (checkbox) set changed. `detail`: `{ paths, nodes }`. Twin: `onCheckedChange(detail)`.

events.name: focus-change
events.description: The focused node changed. `detail`: `{ focusedNode }`. Twin: `onFocusChange(detail)`.

events.name: expanded-change
events.description: The expanded set changed (toggle, keyboard, expandNodes / collapseNodes, expandAll / collapseAll, accordion, data changes) — one event per change: synchronously right after an expand / collapse (after its `node-expand` / `node-collapse`), on the next microtask after a data change. `detail`: `{ paths }` = the whole new set (same as `expandedPaths`). Not fired for `{ isSilent: true }` operations nor for assigning `expandedPaths`. Twin: `onExpandedChange(detail)`.

events.name: nodes-reorder
events.description: A sort (`sortNodes` / `sortAll` / the `sort*` menu items) with a `compareCallback` or `direction: "desc"` rewrote the `orderMember` values (10, 20, 30…) of the children of one parent — one event per parent; never without `orderMember`. `detail`: `{ parentPath, nodes, changes: [{ path, oldOrder, newOrder }] }`. Twin: `onNodesReorder(detail)`.

events.name: tree-change
events.description: The data / structure changed — add / insert / update / move / remove, `applyChanges`, add / insert / replace / removeBranch, paste, drop, duplicate, sort. One event per change (a compound op such as a multi-node drop fires once), on the microtask after it. Not for expand / select / check / focus nor for loading `nodes`; read the new state from `controller.nodes`. `detail`: the context only. Twin: `onTreeChange(detail)`.

events.name: action
events.description: A context-menu item was activated. `detail`: `action` (built-in name or `custom`), `id`, `item`, `source: "context-menu"`, `node` / `path` / `parent` / `siblings`, `sourceEvent`, `triggerElement`. Fires after the item’s `onClick`, before the built-in. Twin: `onAction(detail)`.

events.name: render-start
events.description: A progressive render began (`isRendering` turns true). `detail`: the context only. Twin: `onRenderStart(detail)`.

events.name: render-progress
events.description: A progressive-render batch finished. `detail`: `{ pending, processed }`. Twin: `onRenderProgress(detail)`.

events.name: render-complete
events.description: The progressive render finished (`isRendering` turns false). `detail`: `{ pending, processed }`. Twin: `onRenderComplete(detail)`.

events.name: index-progress
events.description: The async search index filled another batch, and once more with `isComplete: true` at the end — search / filter results are partial until then. `detail`: `{ processed, total, isComplete }`. Twin: `onIndexProgress(detail)`.

events.name: search-status-change
events.description: A filter was applied or cleared (also the automatic re-filter when indexing completes). `detail`: `{ searchTerm, matchCount, isLimited, limit, isIndexing }` — `isLimited` = more matched than `search-result-limit` and the rest were cut off. Twin: `onSearchStatusChange(detail)`.

events.name: container-resize
events.description: The tree container was resized (also once when the tree starts observing). `detail`: `{ size: { width, height }, deviceClass }` — `size` is also `el.containerSize`. Twin: `onContainerResize(detail)`.

events.name: ready
events.description: Fired once after the first live build (core, SPEC §6.3), on the microtask after it; also the `ready` attribute, `:state(ready)`, `isReady` and `whenReady()`. Twin callback `onReady`.

events.name: input-rejected
events.description: Fired when a written value is refused (core, SPEC §6): an invalid attribute or property value, or an unknown `setAttributes()` key. The element warns and keeps its previous value. Detail `{ configKey, attribute?, value, reason?, kept, source }`. Twin callback `onInputRejected`.

properties.name: isArmed
properties.description:
True while the tree is armed (`highlight-on-page-drag` + a node is dragged over
the page + it accepts drops). Mirrors the `armed` attribute / `:state(armed)`.

properties.name: expandedPaths
properties.description:
The expanded set. Assigning replaces it (branches not listed collapse) silently — no
`expanded-change` / `tree-change` (use `expandNodes` / `collapseNodes` to announce); before
the first build the value is held and applied once the tree exists.

properties.name: isRendering
properties.description: True while a progressive render is in flight (`render-start` … `render-complete`). Read-only.

properties.name: containerSize
properties.description: The tree container's last measured size (`container-resize`); `null` before the first measure. Read-only.

properties.name: focusedNode
properties.description: The focused node (read-only — `focusNode(path)` / `clearFocus()` move it).

properties.name: selectedPaths
properties.description:
The selected set (a snapshot). Assigning replaces it silently — no `selection-change` /
`checked-change` / `focus-change` (use `selectNodes` / `clearSelection` to announce).

properties.name: selectionAnchor
properties.description:
The Shift-range anchor (Shift+click / Shift+Arrow extend from it); `null` = none.
Writable — e.g. an alternative renderer keeping its own range selection in sync.

properties.name: checkedPaths
properties.description:
The checked set as emitted (projected through `cascadeCheckPolicy`). Assigning
replaces it silently — no `checked-change` (use `checkNodes` / `uncheckAll` to announce).

properties.name: insertResult
properties.description: Result of the most recent data insert (successful / failed / failedDetails) — read-only state.

properties.name: treeId
properties.description: Stable identifier for this tree (clipboard / cross-tree operations).

properties.name: idMember
properties.description: Property name on a node object that holds its id.

properties.name: pathMember
properties.description: Property name that holds a node materialized tree path.

properties.name: displayValueMember
properties.description: Property name that holds a node display label.

properties.name: parentPathMember
properties.description: Property name holding a node parent path.

properties.name: levelMember
properties.description: Property name holding a node depth level.

properties.name: isExpandedMember
properties.description: Property name flagging whether a node is expanded.

properties.name: isCheckedMember
properties.description: Property name flagging whether a node is checked (checkbox).

properties.name: isDraggableMember
properties.description: Property name flagging whether a node is draggable.

properties.name: isDropAllowedMember
properties.description: Property name flagging whether a drop is allowed onto a node.

properties.name: hasChildrenMember
properties.description: Property name flagging that a node has children (lazy trees).

properties.name: searchValueMember
properties.description: Property name a node is searched against.

properties.name: isSelectableMember
properties.description: Property name flagging whether a node can be selected.

properties.name: isCollapsibleMember
properties.description: Property name flagging whether a node can be collapsed.

properties.name: orderMember
properties.description: Property name used to order sibling nodes.

properties.name: allowedDropPositionsMember
properties.description: Property name listing the drop positions allowed on a node.

properties.name: iconMember
properties.description: Property name that holds a per-node icon value (rendered on every node as <i class="wtv__node-icon {value}">).

properties.name: iconColorMember
properties.description: Property name that holds a per-node icon color (applied to the .wtv__node-icon element).

properties.name: expandLevel
properties.description: Depth to auto-expand on load (0 = roots only, the default).

properties.name: treePathSeparator
properties.description: Separator between segments in a materialized tree path.

properties.name: clickBehavior
properties.description: What a node click does: select, expand, or expand-and-focus (default).

properties.name: shouldExpandAsAccordion
properties.description: Accordion mode: expanding a node collapses its siblings.

properties.name: isSortingEnabled
properties.description: Automatic sorting of siblings (default on). Off: the input order is kept, `addNode` appends, `insertNode` / `insertBranch` / `moveNode` / drop keep the exact position (with `orderMember` the order values are still computed). `sortNodes` / `sortAll` still sort; switching it back on re-sorts the tree.

properties.name: isSorted
properties.description: Hint: data is already in insert order (parents first, siblings ordered) — skips sorting the input; faster on big data.

properties.name: shouldUseInternalSearchIndex
properties.description: Build the internal FlexSearch index that filterNodes / searchNodes / search-term query (default on; `false` = no index, search finds nothing).

properties.name: indexerBatchSize
properties.description: Max nodes indexed per idle slot when building the search index (default 1000). Each slot is also time-boxed (≤16 ms, ≤8 ms when forced on a busy page), which is what keeps the UI smooth.

properties.name: indexerTimeout
properties.description: Idle timeout (ms) between search-index batches.

properties.name: initializeIndexCallback
properties.description: Factory for a custom FlexSearch Index (tokenizer, charset, …) used instead of the built-in one. JS only; a change rebuilds the index.

properties.name: searchTerm
properties.description: Active search/filter term.

properties.name: searchResultLimit
properties.description: Max matches a search / filter returns (default 1000; FlexSearch's own silent default was 100). Check `search-status-change` `detail.isLimited` to tell users the result was truncated.

properties.name: filterScope
properties.description: EXPERIMENTAL — which descendants of a filter match stay visible (ancestors always do): `matches` (default), `descendants` (whole subtree), `tree-depth` (whole subtree for a match at level ≥ max depth − x), `subtree-height` (whole subtree if it is ≤ x levels deep), `levels-below` (x levels under each match). x = filter-descendant-depth.

properties.name: filterDescendantDepth
properties.description: EXPERIMENTAL — the x for the depth-limited filter scopes. Default 1.

properties.name: shouldExpandFilterDescendants
properties.description: EXPERIMENTAL — expand the descendants a filter scope adds (default on). Off: they start collapsed (matches + ancestors stay expanded) — keeps a top-level match on a big tree cheap.

properties.name: bodyClass
properties.description: Extra class on the tree body container.

properties.name: selectedNodeClass
properties.description: Class applied to selected nodes.

properties.name: focusedNodeClass
properties.description: Class applied to the focused node.

properties.name: checkedNodeClass
properties.description: Class applied to checked nodes — opt-in extra styling; the checkbox is the default signal.

properties.name: dragOverNodeClass
properties.description: Class applied to a node being dragged over.

properties.name: draggedNodeClass
properties.description: Class for the dragged source row; replaces the built-in .wtv__node-content--dragged visual.

properties.name: isNodeTooltipsShown
properties.description: Enable hover/focus tooltips on node rows (content from getNodeTooltipCallback).

properties.name: tooltipPlacement
properties.description: Tooltip placement relative to the row. Default top-start.

properties.name: tooltipDelay
properties.description: Show/hide delay (ms). The attribute sets both; the JS property also accepts { show, hide }. Default { show: 400, hide: 100 }.

properties.name: tooltipOffset
properties.description: Gap from the row (or cursor), px. Default 8.

properties.name: shouldTooltipFollowCursor
properties.description: Anchor the tooltip to the pointer instead of the row.

properties.name: iconSet
properties.description: Disclosure glyph set: chevron (default) | triangle | plus-minus | arrow. Re-points the --wtv-icon-* variables via a :host([icon-set]) rule; reflected to the attribute so the CSS matches when set via the JS property.

properties.name: leafIconClass
properties.description: Icon class for leaf nodes.

properties.name: toggleIconMode
properties.description: Whether the toggle glyph rotates (single glyph, default) or swaps (expand↔collapse glyph). Reflected to the attribute so the :host([toggle-icon-mode="swap"]) CSS matches via the JS property.

properties.name: scrollHighlightClass
properties.description: Class flashed on a node after scrollToPath().

properties.name: scrollHighlightTimeout
properties.description: How long (ms) the scroll highlight stays before clearing.

properties.name: nodeTitleOverflow
properties.description: A too-long built-in label: `wrap` (multi-line; rows grow — avoid with virtual scroll), `ellipsis` (single-line clip, default) or `info` (ellipsis + a trailing info button on clipped rows that reveals the full label). renderNodeCallback content owns its layout.

properties.name: shouldAlignNodeIcons
properties.description: Reserve a fixed icon column so node labels align.

properties.name: contextMenuXOffset
properties.description: Horizontal offset (px) of the context menu from the pointer.

properties.name: contextMenuYOffset
properties.description: Vertical offset (px) of the context menu from the pointer.

properties.name: isDisabled
properties.description: Disable the tree like a native form control: no user interaction (check, select, expand / collapse, drag, drop, copy / cut / paste / delete, context menu, keyboard), out of the tab order, `aria-disabled="true"`, dimmed (`--wtv-disabled-tree-opacity`). Programmatic API calls still work. Re-enabling restores everything.

properties.name: isReadonly
properties.description: Read-only tree like a native read-only control: the user cannot change the data — no check, drag, drop, cut / paste / delete (shortcuts and built-in menu items), no sort from the menu — but the tree stays focusable and navigable: keyboard navigation, scroll, expand / collapse, selection highlight and copy work. Not dimmed. Programmatic API calls still work.

properties.name: isLoading
properties.description: Show the loading state.

properties.name: dragDropMode
properties.description: Drag-drop mode: `none` (off, default), `self` (within this tree), `cross` (between trees), or `both`.

properties.name: dropZoneMode
properties.description: Drop-zone visual style: floating indicator or glow (default).

properties.name: dropZoneLayout
properties.description: Where drop zones render relative to a node (default `around`).

properties.name: dropZoneStart
properties.description: Where drop zones begin. A number is a percentage of node width; a string is used as-is (`px` or `%`, e.g. "50px").

properties.name: dropZoneMaxWidth
properties.description: Maximum floating drop-zone width, a CSS length (`120px`, `8rem`, `30%`); a number means pixels on both paths (`drop-zone-max-width="90"` / `el.dropZoneMaxWidth = 90` → `90px`). Default `120px`.

properties.name: isCopyAllowed
properties.description: Allow the copy clipboard operation.

properties.name: shouldAutoHandleCopy
properties.description: Let the tree perform the copy itself (vs delegating to onCopy).

properties.name: shouldAutoHandleMove
properties.description: Let the tree perform a move drop itself (default). `false`: the tree is not mutated — `node-drop` fires and the consumer moves the nodes.

properties.name: shouldAutoHandlePaste
properties.description: Let the tree perform the paste itself (vs delegating to onPaste).

properties.name: shouldHandleKeyboardShortcuts
properties.description: Handle copy/cut/paste/delete keyboard shortcuts.

properties.name: touchDragDelay
properties.description: Long-press hold (ms) before a touch-drag engages (default 300).

properties.name: shouldIndicateUndraggable
properties.description: Built-in "can't move/drop this" feedback (🚫 badge + haptic). Default true.

properties.name: isTreeDropZoneEnabled
properties.description: Make the whole populated tree one drop target (drop lands target=null regardless of per-node drop rules).

properties.name: labels
properties.description: UI strings — a partial object (JSON attribute) merged per key over the English defaults (an empty string = render nothing): `noData` ("No data" — no nodes), `noResults` ("No results found" — the search filter left nothing), `noDisplayValue` ("[N/A]" — node without a display value), `loading` ("Loading…" — spinner aria-label), `dropHere` ("Drop here"), `showFullLabel` ("Show full label" — the node-title-overflow="info" button), `copy`, `cut`, `paste`, `delete`, `expand`, `collapse`, `expandSubtree`, `collapseSubtree`, `expandAll`, `collapseAll`, `sort`, `sortSubtree`, `sortAll` (built-in context-menu items), `back` ("Back") / `close` ("Close") (the context menu as a phone sheet / drawer: submenu back row, header close button). `{name}` placeholders.

properties.name: isEmptyDropPlaceholderShown
properties.description: Show a drop placeholder when the tree is empty.

properties.name: shouldHighlightOnPageDrag
properties.description: Arm the drop target while a tree NODE is dragged anywhere over the page (any tree): the host gets the `armed` attribute + `:state(armed)`, and an empty tree shows its drop zone at once with `--wtv-drop-placeholder-bg-armed` (the zone under the pointer keeps the engaged look). Cleared on drop anywhere, when the drag leaves the window, on Escape / `dragend`, and on disconnect. Never armed while `drag-drop-mode="none"`, disabled or read-only. One shared page listener for all instances (same option as web-dropzone).

properties.name: isFlatRenderingEnabled
properties.description: Render the visible nodes as a flat list (perf).

properties.name: flatIndentSize
properties.description: Indent per level in flat rendering, a CSS length (`20px`, `1.5rem`); a bare number means pixels (`flat-indent-size="20"` → `20px`). Default `var(--wtv-indent-size)`.

properties.name: isProgressiveRenderEnabled
properties.description: Render large trees in progressive batches.

properties.name: initialBatchSize
properties.description: Rows rendered in the first progressive batch.

properties.name: maxBatchSize
properties.description: Maximum rows per progressive batch.

properties.name: isVirtualScrollEnabled
properties.description: Enable virtual scrolling.

properties.name: virtualScrollItemHeight
properties.description: Fixed row height (px) used by virtual scrolling.

properties.name: virtualScrollOverscan
properties.description: Extra rows rendered above/below the viewport when virtualizing.

properties.name: virtualScrollContainerHeight
properties.description: Height of the virtual-scroll viewport, a CSS length (`400px`, `30rem`, `50vh`); a bare number means pixels. Unset: the measured tree height (else 400px).

properties.name: rangeSelectionMode
properties.description: How Shift+click range selection walks the tree (default `visual`).

properties.name: selectionMode
properties.description: Single- (default) or multi-node selection.

properties.name: navigationOverrides
properties.description: Replace individual keyboard-navigation methods (navNextSibling, navPageDown, navSelectNext, …), merged over the defaults. JS property only; `null` restores the defaults.

properties.name: isCheckboxesShown
properties.description: Show a checkbox on each node.

properties.name: checkboxMode
properties.description: Checkbox interaction: `independent` (default) toggles one node; `cascade` toggles the subtree with a tristate box on branches.

properties.name: cascadeCheckPolicy
properties.description: Which paths the checked set EMITS in cascade mode: `rolled-up` (minimal cover), `leaves`, or `all`. Default rolled-up.

properties.name: shouldClickToggleCheckbox
properties.description: A node-row click also toggles its checkbox.

properties.name: nodes
properties.description: The node objects. Assigning replaces the tree (JS API); reading returns the current state once built — every node data object in tree order, mutations included (also `el.controller.nodes`).

properties.name: customStyles
properties.description: CSS injected into the shadow root (a full stylesheet; `@import url(…)` works) — the declarative alternative to `getCustomStylesCallback`, which wins when both are set. Comes after the page-wide `window.components["web-treeview"].customStyles`, so it overrides it.

properties.name: getCustomStylesCallback
properties.description: Returns a CSS string injected into the shadow root (`@import url(…)` works; an imported font is also linked in the document head). Wins over `customStyles`; comes after the page-wide layer, so it overrides it.

properties.name: getDisplayValueCallback
properties.description: Compute a node display label (overrides displayValueMember).

properties.name: getSearchValueCallback
properties.description: Compute the text a node is searched against.

properties.name: getIsExpandedCallback
properties.description: Whether a node starts expanded (overrides isExpandedMember).

properties.name: getIsCheckedCallback
properties.description: Whether a node starts checked (overrides isCheckedMember).

properties.name: getIsSelectableCallback
properties.description: Whether a node can be selected (overrides isSelectableMember).

properties.name: getIsDraggableCallback
properties.description: Whether a node is draggable (overrides isDraggableMember).

properties.name: getIsDropAllowedCallback
properties.description: Whether a drop onto a node is allowed (overrides isDropAllowedMember).

properties.name: getIsCollapsibleCallback
properties.description: Whether a node is collapsible (overrides isCollapsibleMember).

properties.name: getAllowedDropPositionsCallback
properties.description: Which drop positions a node allows.

properties.name: getIconCallback
properties.description: Compute a per-node icon value (overrides iconMember).

properties.name: getIconColorCallback
properties.description: Compute a per-node icon color (overrides iconColorMember).

properties.name: getNodeClassCallback
properties.description: Extra class(es) for a node row (`.wtv__node`).

properties.name: getNodeContentClassCallback
properties.description: Extra class(es) for a node content element (`.wtv__node-content`).

properties.name: getNodeTooltipCallback
properties.description: Tooltip content for a node — plain text or a built HTMLElement. Requires show-node-tooltips.

properties.name: sortCallback
properties.description: Orders the children of one parent: `ctx.nodes` are siblings — return them in the new order. Not called on the input under `sorted` (still used by addBranch / addNode / move re-sorts).

properties.name: getContextMenuItemsCallback
properties.description: The context-menu entries for the right-clicked node (`ctx.node`, `parent`, `siblings`): core action items (`{ id, text, icon, shortcut, onClick(detail) }`, `get*Callback(ctx)`, `children` / `getChildrenCallback`), `createMenuDivider(text?)`, or a built-in name ('copy' | 'cut' | 'paste' | 'delete' | 'expand' | 'collapse' | 'expand-subtree' | 'collapse-subtree' | 'expand-all' | 'collapse-all' | 'sort' | 'sort-subtree' | 'sort-all'). Every activation fires `action`.

properties.name: renderNodeCallback
properties.description: Custom render for a node row: fill `ctx.contentElement` (render state on the ctx).

properties.name: renderIconCallback
properties.description: Custom per-node icon render (SVG / unicode / markup) into `ctx.iconElement`. Wins over the default class-based <i>.

properties.name: renderEmptyStateCallback
properties.description: Custom render for the empty-tree state into `ctx.containerElement`.

properties.name: renderEmptyZoneCallback
properties.description: Custom render for an empty drop zone.

properties.name: renderLoadingCallback
properties.description: Custom render for the loading state (the `isLoading` overlay), the core shared loader hook: fill `ctx.containerElement` (already `role="status"` + `aria-label` = `labels.loading`); `ctx` = `{ component, context: "overlay", containerElement, element, label }`; may return a cleanup. Beats the page-wide `window.components.renderLoadingCallback`; neither set: the default `.wtv__loader` (`--wtv-loader-*` tokens).

properties.name: renderHeaderCallback
properties.description: Custom render for the tree header.

properties.name: renderFooterCallback
properties.description: Custom render for the tree footer.

properties.name: renderContextMenuCallback
properties.description: Take over the whole context menu: fill `ctx.containerElement` (close via `ctx.controller.closeContextMenu()`).

properties.name: renderContextMenuItemCallback
properties.description: Fill one context-menu item button (`ctx.buttonElement`, `ctx.menuItem`); leave it empty for the default.

properties.name: beforeCopyCallback
properties.description: Runs before a copy (synchronous): `false` blocks, a `string[]` replaces the paths.

properties.name: beforeCutCallback
properties.description: Runs before a cut (synchronous): `false` blocks, a `string[]` replaces the paths.

properties.name: beforePasteCallback
properties.description: Runs before a paste (synchronous): `false` blocks (no `node-paste` event), an object redirects the target / position.

properties.name: beforeDeleteCallback
properties.description: Runs before a delete (synchronous): `false` blocks, a `string[]` narrows the paths.

properties.name: beforeDropCallback
properties.description: Runs before a drop (async OK): `false` blocks, an object redirects, a DropGroup[] routes it to several destinations.
properties.type: (ctx: BeforeDropCallbackContext) => false | { position?, operation? } | DropGroup[] | void | Promise<…>

properties.name: beforeDragStartCallback
properties.description: Set-level pre-drag interceptor (synchronous — dragstart): prune/augment/veto the dragged set.

properties.name: beforeCheckboxToggleCallback
properties.description: Runs before a checkbox toggle (`ctx.node`, `ctx.isChecked`, `ctx.affectedPaths`): `false` cancels, a `string[]` overrides the affected paths.

properties.name: beforeExpandCallback
properties.description: Runs before a node expands (toggle, keyboard, expandNodes — not expandAll / seeding / accordion): `false` keeps it collapsed; a Promise defers the expand with a loading state (lazy loading: addBranch the children, then resolve). A throw / rejection keeps it collapsed and is logged (error) through the element's logger.

properties.name: beforeScrollCallback
properties.description: Runs before the tree scrolls a node into view on its own (keyboard move, scrollToPath, paste reveal). Return false to skip the scroll, or options to replace the defaults. Sync.

properties.name: beforeKeydownCallback
properties.description: Runs before the built-in keyboard handling (synchronous): return `false` to suppress it for this key. Drive the tree via `ctx.controller`.

properties.name: beforeActionCallback
properties.description: Runs before a context-menu item activates: `false` cancels its onClick, the `action` event and the built-in.

properties.name: nodeOutputTransformationCallback
properties.description: OUTPUT (egress) transform — clean/redact `ctx.data` as a node leaves the source (copy/cut/copy-drop).

properties.name: nodeInputTransformationCallback
properties.description: INPUT (ingress) transform — derive ids/values from `ctx.data` as a node lands (paste/copy-drop); return null to skip.

properties.name: menuPresentation
properties.description: How the component's context / dropdown menus open: 'auto' (default — a bottom sheet on a phone, the floating menu elsewhere), 'floating', 'sheet' (bottom sheet) or 'drawer' (full-height side panel on `menu-side`). Per device / width through the responsive rules.

properties.name: menuSide
properties.description: The edge a 'drawer' menu slides in from: 'start' (default — left in LTR, right in RTL) or 'end'.

properties.name: shouldDefer
properties.description: Hold the first build (core, SPEC §6.3): while set when the element first connects, nothing is built and every input, callback and listener assigned meanwhile accumulates; `release()` (or removing the attribute) then builds once. Latched after the first build.

properties.name: themeSource
properties.description: Where this element reads its theme from instead of the page (core, SPEC §12.10): a CSS selector (nearest matching ancestor, else the first match), `'closest'` (the nearest ancestor carrying a theme signal), or (property only) an `Element`. Unset = the page.

properties.name: motion
properties.description: Motion level (core, SPEC §12.16): `auto` (default — inherit: the nearest `data-motion` ancestor (a section), else the page level `window.components.motion` / `<html data-motion>`; closest wins), `none` (no transitions, instant scrolling), `snappy` (short) or `smooth` (longer). Sets the shared `--base-duration-*` / `--base-scroll-behavior` tokens on the element through `data-motion`; the OS reduced-motion setting always wins.

properties.name: responsive
properties.description: Instance responsive rules (core, SPEC §6.7): partial configs on two axes — `device` (keyed by device class `mobile` / `tablet` / `desktop`; a mouse device is `desktop` at any width) and `breakpoint` (keyed by the window-width bucket); the breakpoint entry applies first, the device entry over it (device wins). An object or a JSON attribute, e.g. `{"device":{"tablet":{"presentation":"modal"}},"breakpoint":{"mobile":{…}}}`. Beats page rules (`window.components.responsive*`) and values set on the element; never reflects. An entry of `null` ignores the page rules while it matches.

properties.name: responsiveCallback
properties.description: Instance computed responsive rule (core, SPEC §6.7): `(ctx) => partial config | null | undefined`, ctx `{ env, deviceClass, breakpoint, element, component, config }` (`config` = base). Runs after `responsive` (wins key by key); re-runs on environment flips, throttled viewport-width changes, rule and config changes. `null` ignores every page rule.

properties.name: isReady
properties.description: The first build is live (core, SPEC §6.3) — the `ready` event has fired.

properties.name: isDestroyed
properties.description: `destroy()` ran.

properties.name: form
properties.description: The owning form (form-associated components).

properties.name: validity
properties.description: Form validity (SPEC §6.6).

properties.name: validationMessage
properties.description: Form validation message (SPEC §6.6).

properties.name: willValidate
properties.description: Whether the element takes part in form validation.

events.name: node-click
events.description: A node was clicked (a checkbox toggle is not a click — see `checked-change`). `detail`: the node with `path`, `parent`, `siblings`. Twin: `onNodeClick(detail)`.

events.name: node-double-click
events.description: A node was double-clicked. `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeDoubleClick(detail)`.

events.name: node-expand
events.description: A node expanded (toggle, keyboard, `expandNodes`, after any `beforeExpandCallback` load; NOT `expandAll` / expand-level seeding — those only fire `expanded-change`). `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeExpand(detail)`.

events.name: node-collapse
events.description: A node collapsed (toggle, keyboard, `collapseNodes`, an accordion sibling; NOT `collapseAll`). `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeCollapse(detail)`.

events.name: node-copy
events.description: Nodes were copied. `detail`: `{ operation, paths, nodes }`. Twin: `onNodeCopy(detail)`.

events.name: node-cut
events.description: Nodes were cut. `detail`: `{ operation, paths, nodes }`. Twin: `onNodeCut(detail)`.

events.name: node-paste
events.description: A paste ran (not fired when `beforePasteCallback` blocked it). `detail`: the PasteResult (`success`, `count`, `skipped`, `error?`, `entries?`, …). Twin: `onNodePaste(detail)`.

events.name: node-delete
events.description: Nodes were deleted. `detail`: `{ paths, nodes }` (pre-removal snapshots). Twin: `onNodeDelete(detail)`.

events.name: node-drag-start
events.description: A node drag started. `detail`: the drag context (`event`, `dragged`). Twin: `onNodeDragStart(detail)`.

events.name: node-drag-over
events.description: A node was dragged over. `detail`: the drag context. Twin: `onNodeDragOver(detail)`.

events.name: node-drop
events.description: A drop completed. `detail`: `{ source, target, dragged, dropped, position, operation, event }`. Twin: `onNodeDrop(detail)`.

events.name: node-drag-reject
events.description: A locked node was long-pressed / an undraggable drag was attempted. `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeDragReject(detail)`.

events.name: node-drop-reject
events.description: A drop was rejected by the target. `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeDropReject(detail)`.

events.name: selection-change
events.description: The selected set changed. `detail`: `{ paths, nodes }`. Twin: `onSelectionChange(detail)`.

events.name: checked-change
events.description: The checked (checkbox) set changed. `detail`: `{ paths, nodes }`. Twin: `onCheckedChange(detail)`.

events.name: focus-change
events.description: The focused node changed. `detail`: `{ focusedNode }`. Twin: `onFocusChange(detail)`.

events.name: expanded-change
events.description: The expanded set changed (toggle, keyboard, expandNodes / collapseNodes, expandAll / collapseAll, accordion, data changes) — one event per change: synchronously right after an expand / collapse (after its `node-expand` / `node-collapse`), on the next microtask after a data change. `detail`: `{ paths }` = the whole new set (same as `expandedPaths`). Not fired for `{ isSilent: true }` operations nor for assigning `expandedPaths`. Twin: `onExpandedChange(detail)`.

events.name: nodes-reorder
events.description: A sort (`sortNodes` / `sortAll` / the `sort*` menu items) with a `compareCallback` or `direction: "desc"` rewrote the `orderMember` values (10, 20, 30…) of the children of one parent — one event per parent; never without `orderMember`. `detail`: `{ parentPath, nodes, changes: [{ path, oldOrder, newOrder }] }`. Twin: `onNodesReorder(detail)`.

events.name: tree-change
events.description: The data / structure changed — add / insert / update / move / remove, `applyChanges`, add / insert / replace / removeBranch, paste, drop, duplicate, sort. One event per change (a compound op such as a multi-node drop fires once), on the microtask after it. Not for expand / select / check / focus nor for loading `nodes`; read the new state from `controller.nodes`. `detail`: the context only. Twin: `onTreeChange(detail)`.

events.name: action
events.description: A context-menu item was activated. `detail`: `action` (built-in name or `custom`), `id`, `item`, `source: "context-menu"`, `node` / `path` / `parent` / `siblings`, `sourceEvent`, `triggerElement`. Fires after the item’s `onClick`, before the built-in. Twin: `onAction(detail)`.

events.name: render-start
events.description: A progressive render began (`isRendering` turns true). `detail`: the context only. Twin: `onRenderStart(detail)`.

events.name: render-progress
events.description: A progressive-render batch finished. `detail`: `{ pending, processed }`. Twin: `onRenderProgress(detail)`.

events.name: render-complete
events.description: The progressive render finished (`isRendering` turns false). `detail`: `{ pending, processed }`. Twin: `onRenderComplete(detail)`.

events.name: index-progress
events.description: The async search index filled another batch, and once more with `isComplete: true` at the end — search / filter results are partial until then. `detail`: `{ processed, total, isComplete }`. Twin: `onIndexProgress(detail)`.

events.name: search-status-change
events.description: A filter was applied or cleared (also the automatic re-filter when indexing completes). `detail`: `{ searchTerm, matchCount, isLimited, limit, isIndexing }` — `isLimited` = more matched than `search-result-limit` and the rest were cut off. Twin: `onSearchStatusChange(detail)`.

events.name: container-resize
events.description: The tree container was resized (also once when the tree starts observing). `detail`: `{ size: { width, height }, deviceClass }` — `size` is also `el.containerSize`. Twin: `onContainerResize(detail)`.

events.name: ready
events.description: Fired once after the first live build (core, SPEC §6.3), on the microtask after it; also the `ready` attribute, `:state(ready)`, `isReady` and `whenReady()`. Twin callback `onReady`.

events.name: input-rejected
events.description: Fired when a written value is refused (core, SPEC §6): an invalid attribute or property value, or an unknown `setAttributes()` key. The element warns and keeps its previous value. Detail `{ configKey, attribute?, value, reason?, kept, source }`. Twin callback `onInputRejected`.
